title: Ask HN: Who is hiring? (May 2013)
guide_zh: 五月职位交流帖，请招聘方清楚说明工作地点与候选人条件。

excerpt: Please lead with the location of the position and include the keywords INTERN, REMOTE, or H1B if the corresponding sort of candidate is welcome. title: Ask HN: Google workers, sister is visiting S.J. Can she tour the Googleplex?
guide_zh: 患重病的妹妹将去圣何塞，作者求谷歌员工帮助安排园区参观。
author: fumar
excerpt: She is 21 years old and has an inoperable brain tumor. She is recovering from several surgeries. She has limited body movements, but wants to go back to school. She is unsure as to what she wants to study. I think it might inspire her to visit the campus and see people being innovative/productive in an office setting.

title: Ask HN: What Freelancer site do you recommend?
guide_zh: 一次简单外包失败后，作者征集更可靠的自由职业平台。
author: 10dpd
excerpt: Having unsuccessfully attempted to use Freelancer.com to complete a relatively simple job (I could do it myself but don't have time at the moment), I was wondering if HN could suggest a good freelancer sourcing site for relatively straight-forward work? Unfortunately the freelancer marketplace sites seem to be dominated by weak PHP developers.

title: Ask HN: Why can't I login to HN via Firefox?
guide_zh: Chrome 和 IE 能登录、Firefox 却不行，作者求助 HN 登录异常。
author: SeanDav
excerpt: I can login via Chrome or IE, just not Firefox. This behaviour started very recently - a matter of a few hours ago. Also, for future reference, what is the best way to ask about this sort of problem?

title: Are HN comments broken for everyone?
guide_zh: HN 评论只显示空白页，作者询问这是不是所有人都遇到的故障。
